description: This file defines the AppModel class for the Notesnook project, managing navigation, page interactions, and view models for the web application.

classes.name: AppModel
classes.description: Main class managing the application's page interactions, navigation, and view models.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the AppModel with a Playwright Page object and sets up sub-models.

methods.name: goto
methods.description: Navigates to the root URL and waits for the route header to be visible; optionally checks login state.

methods.name: goToNotebooks
methods.description: Navigates to the Notebooks view and waits for the list to load.

methods.name: goToColor
methods.description: Navigates to a color-specific notes view.

methods.name: goToSettings
methods.description: Opens the profile dropdown and navigates to Settings.

methods.name: navigateTo
methods.description: Navigates to a specified section if not already on it.

methods.name: getRouteHeader
methods.description: Retrieves the current route header attribute.

methods.name: isSynced
methods.description: Checks if the app is synchronized.

methods.name: waitForSync
methods.description: Waits for the sync status to reach a specified state.

methods.name: lockAppButton
methods.description: Returns the locator for the lock app button.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Performs a search with the given query and type, returning a SearchViewModel.
